description: Design and document a comparison of session priming strategies: (1) full context dump via zug_get_context, (2) delta-only recap, (3) layered load (active patterns first, full fingerprint on demand). Storybloq has a SESSION_PRIMING_COMPARISON.md suggesting this was a hard design problem for them too. Inform the delta session start ticket (T-3) with empirical data.
title: Session priming comparison — benchmark full load vs. delta approach
